description: Defines a data transfer object (DTO) class OAuthClientSearchFilterParams used for filtering search results related to OAuth clients within the system. Sets a default sort field and restricts sortable fields to OAuth client IDs.

classes.name: OAuthClientSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters related to OAuth clients, extending the generic FilterParams class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field to 'oauthClient.id'.
